Container.Name: Crossfade
Container.DonateText: Like Crossfade? Buy me a coffee.
Container.Overview:
Keeps liked songs, libraries and playlists in sync across music streaming services: one way, both ways or in groups. Several people can share one instance, each with their own services. Supported services and their setup: see the project README.
First start: open the WebUI and create the admin account. It works on your LAN right away; to use it from outside, or with services that sign in through a redirect, put it behind an HTTPS reverse proxy and set Public URL.
Container.Requires: Optional: an HTTPS reverse proxy (e.g. Nginx Proxy Manager) to reach Crossfade outside your LAN and to connect services that sign in through a redirect. Guide: https://github.com/tg099/crossfade/blob/main/docs/unraid.md

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Port of the web UI (put your reverse proxy, e.g. Nginx Proxy Manager, in front of it).

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, encrypted logins and automatic backups (backups/).

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: HTTPS address of your reverse proxy, exactly as you open it, e.g. https://crossfade.example.com (no trailing /). Needed for service sign-ins that redirect back to Crossfade. Leave empty while you only use http://IP:8765 on your LAN.

Config.Name: Secret Key
Config.Description: Encrypts stored logins. Leave empty and Crossfade creates one in its data folder (secret.key). If you set your own (at least 32 characters, e.g. openssl rand -base64 48), keep it safe and NEVER change it.

Config.Name: Spotify Client ID
Config.Description: Optional, can also be entered in the app under Account → App credentials.

Config.Name: Google Client ID
Config.Description: Optional, for YouTube Music sign-in with a Google code.

Config.Name: TIDAL Client ID
Config.Description: Optional, can also be entered in the app under Account → App credentials.

Config.Name: TIDAL Client Secret
Config.Description: Optional, lets Crossfade search TIDAL for users without a TIDAL account.

Config.Name: Parallel syncs
Config.Description: How many fades may sync at the same time (always one per person).
